intended_object: The canonical splitting of the simplicial object Γ₀(K) in the Dold–Kan construction. Here Γ₀(K)_n = ⨁_{[n]↠[k]} K_k, the nondegenerate part is N_n = K_n, and it sits inside Γ₀(K)_n as the summand indexed by the identity [n]→[n]. This is inferred from the docstring and from the Dold–Kan module.
explanation:
The body matches the standard construction. It takes N n := K.X n. The map ι n is the coproduct inclusion of the summand indexed by `Splitting.IndexSet.id`, i.e. the identity epimorphism [n] ↠ [n]. To prove that Γ₀(K)_Δ is the coproduct of the N_k over the epimorphisms Δ ↠ [k], the proof shows that each structure map restricted to this identity summand is exactly the coproduct inclusion of the corresponding summand. This holds because Γ₀(K)_Δ is defined as that very coproduct.

The setting (a preadditive category with finite coproducts, and chain complexes indexed by ℕ) is the natural one for Γ₀. This is the definition of the Dold–Kan construction itself, not a specialization of a more general Mathlib notion.
